description: The values one job-search filter accepts — skills, categories, seniorities, sources, countries and the rest — each with how many open postings carry it, most common first. A value not listed matches no posting. Use it before filtering on a value you are not sure of, and to fix one a search reported in ignored_values.

contains.description: Keep only values containing this text, e.g. kube; for skills a known alias also finds its value (golang finds go).

filter.description: One of category, seniority, skills, work_mode, regions, countries, cities, sources, employment_type, english_level, relocation.

limit.description: How many values to return, up to 200.

name: list_filter_values
